item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

turns.text: Make this pic into a professional headshot, but keep me recognisably me—don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Quick pls.
turns.agent: Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has insufficient credits, so no headshot was created. Add credits, then I can retry while preserving your recognizable features, age, and natural skin texture.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Turn this portrait into a realistic professional headshot of the exact same woman. Preserve her recognizable identity, facial proportions, apparent age, natural skin texture, pores, lines and individual features. No rejuvenation, beauty filter, skin smoothing, face reshaping, or airbrushing. Keep her dark curly hair and natural subtle smile, gaze toward camera. Retain her gray knit sweater for an authentic smart casual professional look. Replace park background with a clean softly blurred neutral gray studio background. Use flattering soft professional studio lighting, accurate natural skin color, crisp eyes and realistic detail. Head and shoulders framing, centered, with comfortable space above hair. Make only restrained photographic changes, not a makeover.
